text: 2026-09-30 fire-timing measurement (raw linear 60 = set delay 3333us, steady, after reset): mains half-cycle 8324-8346us (spread <=36us) -> mains/ZC ruled out. Fires mostly 3347us (+14us fixed latency) but worst-case ~738us late at a steady level -> esp_timer TASK dispatch (Arduino core has no ISR dispatch; C6 single-core, shares CPU with WiFi) delays some TRIAC fires ~15deg = wavering-brightness flicker. Bleeder (holding current) and 1000us gate pulse (ringing) hypotheses both failed to change the flicker band. Usable window on this bulb: raw 20 (floor) .. ~70 (above ~70 no visible brightening).
